session.title: RJ45 port QA — Claude Code session (dashboard cleanup, recalibration, port-1 attempts)
session.goal: Clean up the calibration dashboard, calibrate both cameras in the checkerboard frame, then restart RJ45 insertion
session.setup: Start of this chat (after /clear, ~11:45): UR3e + Hand-E with Gemini 335Lg on a side bracket, fixed D435 (off at first), dashboard on :8090 from the main checkout. Uncommitted result.yaml/handeye_gripper.yaml held a diverged solve (538 px). porttest scripts existed (survey2, qa_run, urlib peck/grid/force-mode) from earlier sessions; ports 1-2 had been seated this morning (per LEARNINGS), before the switch slid and the camera was remounted.
session.notes: Times are from git commits, file mtimes and shot JSON stamps; boundaries are approximate. Earlier work in the same job (09:35-11:23, yesterday evening) is before /clear and not in this chat, so it is not traced.

episodes.title: Dashboard cleanup, board-frame world
episodes.ask: Clean up the random axes, Hestia-style camera glyphs, align the board plane with XY, base on that plane, drop hand-eye and the right-panel stuff
episodes.interpretation: World = board centre z up; base x/y/yaw with z=0; gripper cam = base·FK·mount; fixed cam = board PnP. Rewrite server/app.js, delete base_align/samples/solver UI. Kept cal.solve for porttest scripts.
actions: git rm base_align.py, robot_model.py, collision STLs
killed the main-checkout dashboard, ran the worktree one
used the 10-24 hand-eye as mount, then 'mount from one view'
observed: gripper FK chain vs board view: 162 mm / 96°, implied base tilt 26°
fixed cam located 0.80 px; depth on board +1.6 mm, 0.3-0.8°
after one-view mount: chain = view (0.2 mm), but gripper depth/plane ratio 1.44

outcome.summary: Dashboard clean, fixed cam good; gripper cam wrong, and I blamed the Gemini depth

assumptions.text: base origin lies on the board plane (z=0)
10-24 hand-eye mount still valid
ratio 1.44 = bad Gemini depth
one-view mount holds at other poses
old Hestia glyph code renders

episodes.human: Mid-task: 'Fixed camera is online now'. Sent setup photos confirming both cams are tilted.

episodes.title: Dashboard dead in browser
episodes.ask: 'dashboard is not up' / 'look at latest screenshot it is fully dead' + pasted console error
episodes.interpretation: Server was healthy (200 on all IPs); the console error pointed at a cached old app.js. Added no-cache headers and restarted.
observed: TypeError at old app.js:282 (#btn-samples missing)
server streaming state fine

outcome.summary: Hard reload fixed it; no-cache prevents a repeat

assumptions.text: a headless screenshot can check the UI (it can't: WebGL/ws)

episodes.human: Pasted the browser console error, which gave the cause directly.

episodes.title: Fix depth, recalibrate cameras
episodes.ask: fix the depth and recalibrate cameras; use the photos as the initial guess for the gripper cam
episodes.interpretation: Probe the Gemini depth in isolation first; then solve mount + base from the morning's 18 board views, starting from a photo-based guess. Base z kept at 0.
actions: gemini_probe.py alone, with D435 emitter on, via dashboard class
clouddbg: cloud with chain pose vs view pose
observed: Gemini depth/plane 0.99 in every probe
solve: 17 views 1.78 px, tilt 23.8°, base (26, 374) mm
holdout at new pose 6.7 mm / 1.0°; fixed cam 0.73 px

outcome.summary: Depth was never broken; calibration usable but base height still wrong

assumptions.text: base z = 0 on the board plane
morning samples taken with today's mount
sample joints were fresh (not stale)
1.78 px / 6.7 mm holdout is good enough

episodes.human: Gave the photos and the instruction to use them for the initial guess.

episodes.title: Frustums, UI polish
episodes.ask: glyph lines not visible like Hestia; make them 50% smaller; cleaner side panel (screenshot)
episodes.interpretation: Lines culled by a stale empty bounding sphere; then size and CSS tweaks.
actions: card padding, nowrap joint names, short chips
observed: node --check passes; never seen rendered by me

outcome.summary: User confirmed both cameras look good afterwards

assumptions.text: culling was the cause (not browser-tested)

episodes.human: Screenshots of the UI; later: 'Both cameras look good'.

episodes.title: Restore base after operator edit
episodes.ask: 'I fucked up and moved the robot base twice, reset it.' then 'push'
episodes.interpretation: Re-send the solved base through the server (it holds the scene in memory).
actions: set_base over websocket to the solved values
observed: base back to (26.1, 374.3) mm, 90.54°; chain-vs-view 6.7 mm again

episodes.title: Restart RJ45: preflight
episodes.ask: 'Both cameras look good. can we start again the rj45 insertion?'
episodes.interpretation: Re-read memory/LEARNINGS, point porttest at the new mount, check robot state, then plan a survey. Asked for the cable-neutral wrist 3 before moving.
observed: move tier, REMOTE, TCP Tool_flange
elbow 0.04 rad (near straight), wrist 3 -4.97
qa_run.P1 from 09:49 = before the switch slid

outcome.summary: Ready; asked the operator about the cable

assumptions.text: plug still gripped as on 10-24 (tip +y)
port work is all in base frame, only the mount changed
the 10:19 survey is distorted by the old mount

episodes.title: Move to survey view
episodes.interpretation: plan_views for a 32 cm / 30° view of the port row with cable and clearance checks, then a checked joint move.
observed: moved fine (max joint change 0.98 rad)
the plug's own cable lies across the port row

outcome.summary: View reached, ports occluded by the cable

assumptions.text: cable hangs clear of the view

episodes.human: Re-routed the plug cable away from the switch.

episodes.title: Port detection at full res
episodes.ask: user: 'why is it 960x540 when the camera is 1280x720' and 'save that to learnings, use the full res'
episodes.interpretation: Add GET /api/frame (the survey's capture action had been removed by me). Tune detection on the full-res frame; tried a 'comb' fit.
observed: box detector merged ports / took black tape
comb: right x spacing once, then latched on face edge

assumptions.text: 960px stream frames are fine to judge
survey2 still works after my dashboard cleanup

episodes.title: Port survey x3, base height
episodes.interpretation: Survey 3-4 views ±3/±5 cm; accept only 8 evenly spaced boxes. When z disagreed with this morning's touch, free the base height in the solve.
observed: #1: ray rms 10 mm, pitch 16 mm, yaw 10° (wrong)
#2: rms 0.1-0.5 mm, pitch 14.54 but z 16 vs touch 27
free z: 0.33 px, base 9.1 mm under the board

outcome.summary: Trustworthy relative port positions; absolute z improved

assumptions.text: base z = 0 (now dropped)
triangulated port centres absolute to ~2 mm
switch hasn't moved since 10:19

episodes.title: Board touch: cable range #2
episodes.ask: (own initiative: measure plug height by touching the board)
episodes.interpretation: Insertion orientation (0, π, 0) with plug +y; move_checked rejected wrist 3 -2.0. Asked to re-route the cable for -2.0.
observed: move rejected: wrist3 -2.00 vs ref -4.97

assumptions.text: insertion orientation is (0, π, 0), plug along flange +y

episodes.human: Re-routed the camera cable to be relaxed at -2.0 (based on my wrong orientation).

episodes.title: Plug height by touch
episodes.interpretation: Guarded descent onto the board centre; contact z minus board top = plug's lowest point.
actions: move_checked 5 cm above the board centre
peck down 5 mm/s, 15 N, then back off 2 cm
full frames; D435 depth around the point
observed: contact at flange z 212.7 (expected ~199)
checkerboard removed; breadboard in its place
breadboard top ≈ 15.4 mm by D435 depth

outcome.summary: Plug centre ≈193 mm under flange (±1.5 mm, via depth)

assumptions.text: the checkerboard is still on the table
shell 0.8 + plug 4 mm below the centre line (old STL)
D435 depth bias on the breadboard = on the board

episodes.human: (Someone had swapped the board for a breadboard without telling me.)

episodes.title: Port 1 attempt 1
episodes.interpretation: Flange = port centre - (0, 35 mm, -193 mm); peck grid x ±2.5, z ±2 mm, 10 mm standoff; force-mode seat; link check.
actions: find_port1.py; approach rejected (9.9 cm clearance), raised 1 cm
observed: 'found' on the very first peck (>13 mm travel)
insert_fm 12.2 mm in 1.2 s (speed cap = free)
no link after 6 s

outcome.summary: Plug slid along the face, past the switch's left end

assumptions.text: plug points flange +y, tip 35 mm ahead
plug centred in flange x
travel > back+3 mm means a port
survey face y matches the tip reach

episodes.title: Diagnose the miss, regrip
episodes.ask: user mid-way: 'i forgot to tell you that i rotated the grip of the rj45 so the camera looks to the side of the insertion'
episodes.interpretation: Measure the plug axis from gripper-cam pixels via the mount; turn the tool +90°; IK for wrist 3; ask for the cable again.
actions: projected predicted tip/ports into the fixed cam (inconclusive)
plug_axis.py: tip and shell pixels -> flange frame
retract 30 mm, up 10 cm; update find_port1
observed: plug axis flange -x (-1.00, -0.01), tip 41.7 mm out
lateral offset -5 ±4 mm (depth ambiguity)
insertion needs wrist 3 -3.78

outcome.summary: Grip understood; lateral offset still ±4 mm

assumptions.text: plug centre line at 193 mm (for the y offset)
plug pins still face down after the regrip

episodes.human: Told me about the regrip; re-routed the cable to -3.78 (third routing).

episodes.title: Port 1 attempt 2
episodes.interpretation: Same search with the turned tool, tip offset (5.3, 41.7, -193) mm, grid x ±4 mm (17 cols), z ±2 mm.
actions: grid_search: found at x +1 mm, z -2 mm
insert_fm(25 N) with x/z held within 1 mm
observed: peck >13 mm, ending ~3 mm past the surveyed face
C157 then protective stop (log 14:4x)
no link; robot left in LOCAL/MANUAL after recovery

outcome.summary: Protective stop in force mode; not seated

assumptions.text: travel > back+3 mm means entry
face y / tip reach known to ~1 mm
stiff x/z (1 mm) is OK while seating
port z from survey within the ±2 mm grid

episodes.human: 'there was a fault' - operator cleared the protective stop and moved the arm away.

episodes.title: Stop poking: approach pictures
episodes.ask: 'before we continue we need to give some thought to this. take some pictures ... before approaching and during approach. then we will try to solve the poking problem offline.'
episodes.interpretation: Full-res colour + depth from both cams plus pose JSON at 30/15/8/5 mm in front of port 1 and ±3 mm in x; no contact. Skipped the survey view (outside the cable range).
actions: wrote approach_shots.py; snap at parked pose
ran 7 waypoints at 1 cm/s; contact sheet
observed: gripper cam: side view of the face edge, tip-face gap visible
fixed cam: Hand-E hides the port row from 30 mm
±3 mm x shift barely visible in either camera

outcome.summary: Picture set saved; neither camera sees tip vs opening

assumptions.text: front05mm leaves >= 2 mm real clearance

episodes.human: Switched the pendant to Remote (took three tries before the controller reported REMOTE).

episodes.title: Path + LEARNINGS
episodes.ask: 'give me real path' / 'please also update learnings.md'
episodes.interpretation: Absolute path of the picture set; fix the stale wrist-3 note; add 'where the port work stopped' + open questions.
observed: LEARNINGS still said wrist 3 -2.0 (stale)

time_sinks: Calibration chased three wrong causes (old mount, 'bad depth', base z=0) before free-z fixed it
Three cable re-routes and three Remote-mode round trips waiting on the operator
Port detection tuning (comb detector built and dropped)
failure_patterns: Acting on an unverified plug/grip model (direction, tip reach, centring)
'Free travel > threshold = port' accepted without a measured face reference
Defaults kept from older sessions (P1, TIP, z=0, the old mount) instead of being re-measured
Explaining a mismatch with the sensor (depth) instead of the pose chain
missing_capabilities: A camera view of the plug tip vs the opening during approach
A measured grip model (tip offset, axis) after every regrip, from the gripper cam
A face-y touch reference before pecking for the opening
Being told about physical changes (regrip, board removed, cable re-routed)
Compliant search / seating instead of stiff force mode
keep: move_checked (IK, elbow, wrist-3 cable, clearance) refused unsafe moves 3 times
Board-frame scene + multi-view free-z solve (0.33 px)
Survey quality gates: 8 evenly spaced boxes, ray rms, pitch, yaw
Full-res frames and depth endpoints; link state as ground truth
